maham, 2026 ♡
(A letter)
Some people don’t announce themselves. They change a room just by being in it.

You do that, Maham, and I don’t think you know it. I’ve noticed how gentle you are when it would be easier not to be, and how tightly you hold on to your faith and to people.

I’ve also noticed how hard you can be on yourself. Tonight, remember that the person you keep doubting is someone a lot of us are quietly grateful for. A new year doesn’t make you older so much as more yourself. Stay that.

Happy birthday.
